programs.title: Wild Pacific Rescue
programs.sub_title: Battle to Save a Sea Lion
programs.desc: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

programs.title: Wild Pacific Rescue
programs.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programs.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack
programs.desc: Welcome the rains as an emotional Julz says farewell to the dog packs. He discovers the Stork Colony pups hunting guinea fowl, and is heartened to find the Kakuli pups feeding on an antelope carcass. The playful Manzi pack corner a tough warthog.

director: Helen Royle: Series Producer, Jules Braatvedt: On-Screen DP & Narrator

programs.title: Rooted
programs.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year.

programs.title: Deep Dive North America
programs.desc: Strap in for a thrilling ride as Lizzie travels by air, land, and sea to meet Alaskan wildlife and visit the world’s remotest corners. Eavesdrop on underwater Arctic residents with scientists, dine with polar bears, and scavenge with bald eagles.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward, Executive Producer: Emma Ross

programs.title: Deep Dive North America
programs.desc: Trek through the Canadian rainforest, look up at dizzying redwood trees, and explore giant kelp forests with Lizzie as she experiences the wild west coast of North America. Cross paths with wolves and bears while salmon travel upstream to lay eggs.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward, Executive Producer: Emma Ross

programs.title: Deep Dive North America
programs.desc: Dip into North America’s southern coastal waters, where opalescent squid mate, sea turtles nest, and mobula rays take flight for the sake of romance. Fly a specialized drone with Lizzie as she swoops in for a breath sample from a blue whale.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward, Executive Producer: Emma Ross

programs.title: Deep Dive North America
programs.desc: Marvel at North America’s natural wonders as Lizzie swims through astonishing coral reefs, digs for ancient fossils, and treks through jungles on tropical shores. Prowl with jaguars that stalk a Costa Rican beach and meet the planet’s biggest sharks.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward, Executive Producer: Emma Ross

programs.title: Deep Dive North America
programs.desc: Tag along with Lizzie on her most dangerous Atlantic adventure yet: free diving with bull sharks. Explore otherworldly Gulf Coast swamps filled with hungry alligators, crafty snapping turtles, and tiny but mighty beach mice who strengthen sand dunes.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward, Executive Producer: Emma Ross

programs.title: Deep Dive North America
programs.desc: Bundle up as Lizzie heads north to tag sharks and witness first-hand the slow, sobering disappearance of sea ice. Do time in bear jail with polar bears who are caught raiding a town for food after their icy hunting grounds diminish.

director: Presenter: Lizzie Daly, Director: Mark Woodward, Executive Producer: Emma Ross

programs.title: The Living Beach
programs.desc: Florida is famous for its sandy shores—and there’s plenty to go around. Florida has the most tidal shoreline of any state in the continental USA. These ocean-side playgrounds are also critical habitats for threatened and endangered species.

programs.title: The Living Beach
programs.desc: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive.
